messages.subject: Project Kestrel - COMPLETION confirmed
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Kestrel has completed today. The subscription monies of £20,000,000 have been received, the 2,000,000 Series B Preferred Shares have been allotted to Ravensworth Ventures, the register of members has been updated and the amended Articles have been adopted. Aisha Chowdhury is appointed to the board with effect from today.

Attached is the executed Subscription Agreement for your records. The IRA and Articles, plus the SH01 filing, will follow.

Thank you all for a smooth process.

Kind regards,
James
James Osei  |  Senior Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
